fusions.name: Behind the Knee
fusions.desc: You catch an enemy behind the knee with the staff's crook, dealing 11 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathering Crook
fusions.desc: You sweep the crook of the staff through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Hauled Into Reach
fusions.desc: You snag up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles on the crook and pull them onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Already Snagged
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 12% against an enemy already caught by one of your conditions.
